ML Engine integration broken with 1.11
### Description

Trying to train translate_ende_wmt32k demo with ml-engine, got tensorflow version mismatch error. 

looks like t2t 1.11 introduced [tensorflow_probability](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor/blob/c67f1c9d921795a91889082edd2eb08552705178/tensor2tensor/layers/common_layers.py#L32), which added an dependency of tensorflow 1.12. Based on the ML Engine [runtime versions](https://cloud.google.com/ml-engine/docs/tensorflow/runtime-version-list): it currently supports up to tensorflow 1.10. Thus t2t 1.11 can no longer submit ML Engine training job.
